title: torch.linalg.eigh(torch.randn(4096,4096)) fails on cpu
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

I am unable to do: torch.linalg.eigh(torch.randn(4096,4096)) on my machine
I get the error:
Intel oneMKL ERROR: Parameter 8 was incorrect on entry to SSYEVD.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RuntimeError                              Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In[5], line 1
----> 1 torch.linalg.eigh(torch.randn(4096,4096))

RuntimeError: false INTERNAL ASSERT FAILED at "/pytorch/aten/src/ATen/native/BatchLinearAlgebra.cpp":1601, please report a bug to PyTorch. linalg.eigh: Argument 8 has illegal value. Most certainly there is a bug in the implementation calling the backend library.

the problem is only on cpu. cuda works fine

### Versions

I have version: '2.6.0+cu124'

cc @jianyuh @nikitaved @mruberry @walterddr @xwang233 @Lezcano

add_fix_code: LAPACK query functions return workspace size as floating point value, which means
that it might not be accurately represented if it's size exceed mantissa of the
corresponding type. Fix it by adding 1ULP to the value before casting to it
